Home/Root cause first. Then the recommendation.

Methodology

Root cause first. Then the recommendation.

A dashboard can show that something changed. It does not always tell you why. This is how I find out.

  1. 01

    Map

    Agree the problem, the decision and the operating journey.

  2. 02

    Measure

    Build a baseline people can trust.

  3. 03

    Diagnose

    Test possible causes against the evidence.

  4. 04

    Rebuild

    Select the first useful intervention, give it an owner, and check whether it works.

How I label evidence

Plain language, visible boundaries.

Sometimes the right answer is to stop. If the evidence does not support the next step, I will say so.

Observed
Seen directly in available evidence.
Calculated
Derived through an explicit calculation.
Assumed
An agreed input that has not been independently verified.
Estimated
A range based on evidence and assumptions.
Recommended
A proposed course of action.
